result: I’d make power structurally incapable of ignoring perspective: anyone making a decision that shapes other people’s lives would briefly but unmistakably experience that decision from the position of the person most affected by it. Not as guilt, not as sentiment—as an unavoidable constraint on action. One change, and most other things would have to reorganize around it.
